crossRefs.note: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
“What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your…
Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;
but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from…
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of…
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not…

translations.web: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.
translations.bsb: For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.
translations.kjv: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
translations.asv: For Sheol cannot praise thee, death cannot celebrate thee: They that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
